Subject (in full) Allegations against the Police appearing in the

Made by and Forwarded by C.D.I. Ross.

With reference to the attached translation, Mr. Hu Mo
(胡牧), editor of the "Shanghai Kwangtung Pao" (上海廣東報),

May 10, 1937.
1
Afternoon Translation.

Shanghai Kwangtung Pao (上海廣東報) :-

TRAGIC INCIDENT FOLLOWING APPEAL

According to a newspaper report, when some
500 workers of the Hung Chong Silk Weaving Factory (鴻昌絲織廠),
Connaught Road, were gathering in front of the factory
premises and submitting an appeal on May 4, some 200 of
them were assaulted and injured by Sikh policemen and
over 20 of the injured hands received serious injuries.
The report added that a worker named Chi Teh-yuen (李德元)
succumbed to serious injuries. This tragedy is worthy
of note.

In the month of May, precautionary measures
are being adopted and unauthorized meetings are not allowed.
However, the submission of a peaceful appeal is a lawful
action. The number of the workers was only some 500 and
it did not seem that they would produce any evil influence
on peace and order. Yet Sikh policemen committed violence
in the extra-Settlement roads area. We believe that
persons who love the labouring masses will become indignant
at such an atrocious action.

（印：MUMAY 1937）
S.S.

下午译文。

《上海广东报》（Shanghai Kwangtung Pao）：-

请愿引发的悲剧事件

据报纸报道，5月4日，康纳路（Connaught Road）鸿昌丝织厂约500名工人聚集在厂址前提交请愿书时，其中约200人遭到锡克族巡捕殴打致伤，20多名受伤工人伤势严重。报道还称，一名名叫李德元（Chi Teh-yuen）的工人因重伤身亡。此悲剧值得注意。

五月期间，当局正采取预防措施，禁止未经授权的集会。然而，和平请愿属于合法行为。工人人数仅约500人，似乎不会对治安秩序产生任何恶劣影响。然而，锡克族巡捕却在越界筑路区域施暴。我们相信，爱护劳工大众的人士会对这种残暴行径感到愤慨。

（印：MUMAY 1937）
S.S.

Shanghai Kwangtung Pao (上海廣東報) dated April 3:-

CORRECTION

On April 1 this paper published an article
entitled "Are Ricsha Coolies Not Human Beings?",
written by Zung Teh Ming(陳德明). It has been
found that the remarks contained in this article
are untrue. We therefore publish this
correction.
pages.zh:
1937年4月3日《上海广东报》（Shanghai Kwangtung Pao）：-

更正

本报于4月1日刊登了一篇题为《黄包车夫难道不是人吗？》的文章，作者为陈德明（Zung Teh Ming）。经查，该文所含言论不实。故特此刊登更正。

pages.en:
The Shanghai Kwangtung Pao(上海廣東報) publishes the following
letter from Zung Teh Ming(陳德明) :-

ARE RICSHA COOLIES NOT HUMAN BEINGS?

What I wish to write about here is the unreasonable
assaults on ricsha coolies.
Ricsha coolies are considered by the upper classes
as outcasts and low class human beings. That they are being
assaulted is a matter not worthy of consideration. Even the
death of several coolies as a result of assault will not
cause any surprise. Is it not a fact that a ricsha coolie
was beaten to death by an American sailor about a month ago?
Who are the persons who assault ricsha coolies?
They are foreign sailors, Indians, "lordly" policemen, loafers,
etc. and all of them are qualified to assault ricsha coolies,
particularly the "lordly" policemen. I cannot understand why
the policemen who are themselves looked upon with contempt by
the upper classes molest the ricsha coolies who are similarly
despised. Is it not a fact that the policemen are not able
to show their authority without assaulting ricsha coolies?

（批：Sp. Bn. ?）
（印：C.C. 192 APR. 1 * SHANGHAI *）
pages.zh:
《上海广东报》（Shanghai Kwangtung Pao）刊登陈德明（Zung Teh Ming）的如下来信：-

黄包车夫难道不是人吗？

本人此处欲述者，乃针对黄包车夫之无理殴打。
黄包车夫被上层阶级视为弃民及下等人。他们遭受殴打被视为不值一提之事。即便数名车夫因殴打致死，也不会引起任何惊讶。约一个月前，一名黄包车夫被一名美国水手殴打致死，这难道不是事实吗？
殴打黄包车夫者是何人？
他们是外国水手、印度人、“老爷式”巡捕、游手好闲之徒等，这些人都有资格殴打黄包车夫，尤其是那些“老爷式”巡捕。本人无法理解，为何同样被上层阶级蔑视的巡捕，要去骚扰同样被鄙视的黄包车夫。难道巡捕不通过殴打黄包车夫就无法显示其权威，这不是事实吗？

（批：特别处？）
（印：C.C. 192 4月1日 * 上海 *）
